title: retrieval-eval judgment
description: One relevance judgment. A judgments file is JSONL: one of these per line.

query.description: Query text. Required on at least one row per query_id.

chunk_id.description: Content-addressed chunk id. Omit for document-level judgments.

text_sha.description: Hash of the normalized labeled text. Enables drift re-anchoring without storing text.

chunk_text.description: The labeled text. Enables SPLIT detection. Omit for sensitive corpora.

relevance.description: Graded relevance. 0 = not relevant. TREC convention: 0-3.

corpus_fingerprint.description: State of corpus+chunker+embedder this judgment was made against.

labeled_by.description: Provenance, e.g. 'human:ana' or 'synthetic:claude-haiku-4-5'. Prefix with human: or synthetic:.

stratum.description: Query category, for coverage reporting instead of averages.
